name: LPU Online

about.text: Lovely Professional University (LPU) is a top-ranking university in India in various academic disciplines, ranked by NIRF. LPU Online is no different, as it is one of the top online education providers in India.

The university has various affiliations, including recognition from the University Grants Commission (UGC), the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), and World Education Services (WES). The university has been ranked by NIRF, WURI, and The World University Rankings 2022. The quality of education this university provides is quite evident from its NAAC A++ grading.

The university offers online UG and PG courses in the domains of Management, Computer Applications, Commerce, Arts, and science. The curriculum for every course is industry-oriented, as it has been designed by expert practitioners and experienced faculty. Apart from academic learning, the university conducts skilling classes conducted by a dedicated team of in-house professors.

about.text: The university has its own Learning Management System (LMS) that can be accessed as a mobile app, which is quite user-friendly and has customized features to ensure students have a seamless learning experience.

There are live online classes with real-time interaction between the faculty and students to offer a structured opportunity to communicate. This is to make sure that online learners have an innovative classroom experience. However, the live lectures are recorded and made available for all to access to provide maximum flexibility to the students.

The university regards extracurricular activities and encourages its online learners to join community service groups. This not just deviates students from mundane academics but also allows them to build strong networks and share their innovative thoughts with the community.

facts: LPU Online is approved by UGC-DEB to offer UG and PG degrees in the online mode.
The university has its own LMS which can be accessed as a mobile app as well.
The examinations are conducted in the online mode with remote proctoring using various Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools.
The students can access exclusive resources like case studies, scholarly articles, and journals.
Students can take up various additional online certification courses conducted by the university to enhance their resumes.
The students have the opportunity to undertake research endeavors as the university has world-class research facilities and infrastructure for the same.
The university regularly conducts seminars, workshops, and mock interviews for professional enhancement and webinars by eminent speakers from relevant industries.

emi.text: Nowadays, education loans and other financing options are available out there to easily pursue what the student wants to pursue with no financial stress. LPU online also offers students these available options to easily finance their education.

admission.text: The admission procedure at LPU Online takes place in online mode. The fresh admission batches start every 6 months. The admission session generally starts in the months of January and July of every year. Direct admission is done on the basis of one’s educational qualifications; no other entrance exams are conducted for taking admission. The admission procedure 2023 for the online courses at LPU Online is as follows:
Step 1: The first step is registration. You have to sign up and pay a registration fee of ₹500.
Step 2: The Next step is to fill out the online application form and upload relevant documents.
Step 3: Now, you have to pay the program fee.
Step 4: The university will verify the documents and notify you for further procedures.
Step 5: Upon approval from the university, you will get your LMS credentials via email.

faqs.q: Is LPU online approved by UGC?
faqs.a: Yes, the LPU has been approved by UGC-DEB to offer degree courses in online mode.

faqs.q: Which courses are offered at LPU online?
faqs.a: The university offers online UG and PG courses in the domains of Management, Computer Applications, Commerce, Arts, and Science.

faqs.q: What are the facilities provided by LPU online?
faqs.a: Apart from quality education, LPU online provides its students access to exclusive study resources like scholarly articles and journals, case studies, and more. They also provide additional online certification courses and research opportunities. Also, there are regular seminars, workshops, mock interviews, and webinars by professionals and experts from the industry.

faqs.q: Are examinations conducted in the online mode at LPU?
faqs.a: Yes, the examinations are conducted in a completely online mode through the Learning Management System (LMS) and are remotely proctored using the latest AI technology.

faqs.q: Does LPU online have its own LMS?
faqs.a: Yes, the university has its own LMS which can also be accessed as a mobile app. It has the latest and customized features for a seamless, flexible, and efficient learning environment.
